scene: 机场出行 - 打车 Taxi
listening: lunanotes.io - Master English Taxi Conversations: Practical Phrases & Tips Abroad

sentences.en: Can you take me to the train station?
How much is the fare to the airport?
Please take the faster route if you can.
sentences.cn: 如果可以的话，请走快的路线。

sentences.en: Here you go. Keep the change.
Can you stop here? This is fine.
sentences.cn: 能停这儿吗？这儿就可以了。

sentences.en: Could you hold your phone up so I can see the GPS?
sentences.cn: 能把手机举起来让我看清导航吗？

sentences.en: We should be there in about fifteen minutes.

vocabulary.meaning: 可用的；有空的（指出租车是否在载客）

practice: Passenger: Taxi! Excuse me, are you available? Driver: Yes, where to? Passenger: Please take me to the train station. Driver: Sure, hop in. Passenger: How long will it take? Driver: About fifteen minutes, depending on traffic.
